summary: Iteration 15 — final dress rehearsal re-verification of 3 fixes (frontend only). ALL 3 FIXES PASS. FIX1 (no voice overlap): opening the crisis demo while the Guardian greeting is speaking immediately unmounts [data-testid=guardian-subtitle] (asserted None ~400ms after click). FIX2 (unique scorecard reset testID): /scorecard renders exactly one [data-testid=judge-reset-btn-scorecard] and zero [data-testid=judge-reset-btn]; clicking it hard-navigates to '/' and the entrance gate [data-testid=enter-with-sound-btn] reappears. FIX3 (demo timer 240s): [data-testid=demo-timer-badge] reads 'DEMO · 3:59' immediately after opening the demo (i.e. 240s starting value) and counts down (observed 3:57 after ~2.5s). Timed journey smoke verified end-to-end: entrance gate → tap enter → launch video plays → SKIP → hub → greeting subtitle appears → open crisis demo → BEGIN WITH GUARDIAN VOICE gate visible → scorecard direct-load → scorecard-subtitle observed (auto-login + narration working). No red screen, no console errors beyond expected CanvasKit fetch warning and RCTAnimation useNativeDriver warning (both harmless web-preview limits noted in prior iterations).

issues: demo-timer-badge is rendered in the root layout beneath the Modal on web (React Native Web portals Modal above absolute-positioned root children), so the '4:00' pill is not visually apparent while the demo modal is open even though its DOM node exists and counts down. Not part of the current fix scope — the badge still triggers auto-navigation to /scorecard at 0. Flagging for E1's awareness only.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): re-parent DemoTimerBadge above the JudgeDemo Modal (e.g. render inside the Modal or via a top-level portal) so judges can visibly see the 4:00 countdown while the demo is open.
No blocking changes needed — all 3 fixes verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: hub demo onPress correctly calls stopGreeting.current?.() and setSpokenLine(null) BEFORE startDemoTimer(240) + setAboutOpen(true) — clean ordering, no race.
JudgeReset now takes optional testID prop with default 'judge-reset-btn'; scorecard passes 'judge-reset-btn-scorecard' — clean, backwards-compatible API.
demo-timer.tsx DEMO_SECONDS default is still 180 but callers pass 240 explicitly — safe. Consider raising the default to 240 for consistency.
